# langsmith_data_plane (Resource)

Provisions a hybrid/self-hosted (BYOC) data plane for the current LangSmith organization. The API accepts the request and returns the data plane in status `requested`; provisioning continues asynchronously. Requires BYOC to be enabled on the org and org-admin permissions. **The API offers no update or delete endpoint**: every configurable attribute forces replacement, and `terraform destroy` only removes the resource from state — the data plane keeps running and must be deprovisioned through LangSmith support.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Provisions a BYOC data plane for the current organization (org-scoped;
# requires BYOC enabled and org-admin permissions). The API has no update or
# delete endpoint: changes force replacement, and destroy only removes the
# resource from state.
resource "langsmith_data_plane" "us_east" {
  name        = "prod-us-east-1"
  region      = "us-east-1"
  external_id = var.langsmith_external_id
  role_arn    = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/langsmith-byoc"
  vpc_cidr    = "10.42.0.0/16"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `external_id` (String, Sensitive) Value LangSmith presents as `ExternalId` when assuming `role_arn`. Must match the `ExternalId` condition in the customer role's trust policy. Not returned by the API, so it cannot be refreshed from the server.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Display name of the data plane.
- `region` (String) Cloud region the data plane is provisioned in (e.g. `us-east-1`).
- `role_arn` (String) ARN of the customer IAM role LangSmith assumes to provision the data plane. Not returned by the API.
- `vpc_cidr` (String) CIDR block for the data plane VPC. Not returned by the API.

### Read-Only

- `api_url` (String) API URL of the data plane once provisioned.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) UUID of the data plane.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status: `requested`, `provisioning`, `provisioning_failed`, `active`, `inactive`, `deprovisioning`, `deleted`, or `revoked`. Starts at `requested` and advances asynchronously.
- `workspaces` (String) JSON-encoded list of workspaces (`[{"id": ..., "name": ...}]`) attached to this data plane.
